whoWeAre.body: The Centre for Artificial Intelligence, Kirori Mal College, is Delhi University's first AI-based learning and innovation ecosystem — dedicated to making artificial intelligence accessible to every curious mind. In our first official year, we're bringing students and enthusiasts from across Delhi University together to learn, build, and explore AI without barriers. CAI is more than a centre — it's a community for anyone who wants to understand the technology shaping tomorrow.

whatWeDo.heading: Four ways we bring AI within reach.
whatWeDo.intro: From structured research to open speaker sessions — every track is built to move a curious student from first exposure to real capability.
